summary: Build tax risk, control, and reporting skills with practical TCRM tools. Learn to manage compliance exposure with confidence in 5 days.
lede: Tax risk management and compliance is a structured way to identify, prioritize, and address tax exposure through controls, data, and governance. For tax managers, compliance officers, internal auditors, and finance professionals involved in tax data or oversight, it supports risk-based filing and control work through risk registers, obligation calendars, and scoring or heatmaps that help prioritize action.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who already work with tax reporting, compliance checks, or control oversight and need a stronger risk-based approach. It is also useful for adjacent finance and audit roles that influence tax data, deadlines, reconciliations, and management reporting.
prerequisites: You should bring experience with tax filing cycles, reconciliations, or compliance review work. A laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to sample tax reports or compliance registers will help you complete the hands-on exercises. Where possible, bring examples of filing calendars, audit findings, or tax control documents from your current role.
